note: What a server sends to say a unit is casting a spell. The header names the unit casting, as the casting inside does.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: It settles whether a client brings the caster's position in line for this cast, and nothing else.

fields.name: cast
size
fields.note: How many bytes the casting holds, this field included: 86, and 17 more for each hit. What a client does where it holds anything else is not recorded.

fields.name: spell
fields.note: Which spell, by the number its name gives, as spec/objects.md works it out.

fields.name: castId
fields.note: The name this casting answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The rank the spell stands at, counting from 1: a spell at its first rank carries 1.

fields.name: attackSpeed
fields.note: What the caster's attack rhythm is scaled by while this runs.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: The unit casting.

fields.name: chainOwner
fields.note: The unit the casting is credited to, where a chain of casts leads back to another. That meaning is not fully recorded.

fields.name: targetX
fields.note: Where the casting is aimed, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: targetY
fields.note: Where the casting is aimed, in height, in world units.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.note: Where the casting is aimed, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: targetEndX
fields.note: Where the casting stops being aimed, for a spell that sweeps, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: targetEndY
fields.note: Where the casting stops being aimed, for a spell that sweeps, in height, in world units.

fields.name: targetEndZ
fields.note: Where the casting stops being aimed, for a spell that sweeps, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: hitCount
fields.note: How many units the casting names as hit.

fields.name: hits
unit
fields.note: The unit hit.

fields.name: hitX
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded; it is likely where the unit hit stands, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: hitY
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded; it is likely the height of that point, in world units.

fields.name: hitZ
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded; it is likely where the unit hit stands, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: result
fields.note: How the hit landed.
The units the casting hits.

fields.name: castTime
fields.note: How long the casting takes before it takes effect, in seconds.

fields.name: extraCastTime
fields.note: What is added to that, in seconds.

fields.name: totalTime
fields.note: How long the whole casting runs, in seconds.

fields.name: cooldown
fields.note: How long until the spell can be cast again, in seconds.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.note: When the casting began, in seconds.

bits.name: basicAttack
bits.note: Set where the casting is the caster's own swing rather than a spell.

bits.name: secondBasicAttack
bits.note: Set where the swing is the second of a pair.

bits.name: forced
bits.note: Set where the casting was not asked for by whoever holds the caster.

bits.name: overrideCastPosition
bits.note: Set where the aim above replaces the one the caster would have used.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the caster's slots the spell sits in.

fields.name: cost
fields.note: What the casting spends from the caster's resource.

fields.name: launchX
fields.note: Where what the casting throws leaves from, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: launchY
fields.note: Where what the casting throws leaves from, in height, in world units.

fields.name: launchZ
fields.note: Where what the casting throws leaves from, along the other ground axis, in world units.
The casting.

revisions.note: There is no byte for ending a charge: the casting follows the sync id.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: It settles whether a client brings the caster's position in line for this cast, and nothing else.

bits.name: endCharge
bits.note: Set where the cast ends a charge: a client drops the message unless the caster is charging that same spell. Clear lets a client charge a spell that charges, sending SpellCharge as it does.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.
